objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix assigned to the document (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: System-assigned sequential number appended to the abbreviation.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, or related objects.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced or linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period the document is retained after invalidation before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content, relevant for translation.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment tracking its own revisions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment within the main document's release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object added to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional info has been directly published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend an existing released document, managed independently from the document's content and version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring a check on whether to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a document that no longer has validity, triggering an archiving workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring it for a new release cycle.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that manages the steps of release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who may hold one or more roles and participates in document lifecycle events.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role(s) assigned to the user (e.g. Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for authorization assignment, distribution, and role-based access control.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type classification of the group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document to receive notifications or acknowledgement requests upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user-facing and role-specific view displaying documents, tasks, acknowledgements, and evaluation reports relevant to the logged-in user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search report providing filtered information about documents in the system based on selection parameters.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g. Status Report Documents & Instruction, Document Monitoring, Acknowledgement Status).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_metadata
evts.description: Attributes and metadata of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or co-author starts the 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review step of the release workflow.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of review performed (technical or formal).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the document's version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the processing of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator and removing the proposal from the document display.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) processes the validity extension request, deciding to extend, revise, or invalidate.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the validity check (extend, revise, or invalidate).

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document's validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate (put out of force) a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the workflow (releaser-only or 3-step with initiator, reviewer, releaser).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, its last valid version receives the out-of-force status, editing versions are deleted, and archiving begins.

evts.name: revoke_authorizations
evts.description: All authorizations except archive group are revoked from a document upon declaration of out of force.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release of a new document version, users on the distribution list receive an email notification.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, persons on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested by email to confirm they have read the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual users for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is checked and released via a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or pending actions.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g. workflow task, validity extension info, override info, acknowledgement request).

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive duration expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.
